1
Zindan Che Musa Kazim Da Aj Loko Khatam Jahad Hoya.
Be-Kafan Janaza Kazim Ka Haye Khak De Naal Aabaad Hoaya.
Musa Kazim De Zakhma Wich Paiwast Hoiyaan Zanjeeraan Ne.
Haye Baba Raza Da Qaid Wichon Kariyaan Paye Aazaad Hoya.

2
Kadi Hasan Hussain Kadi Zainab Nu Kadi Zahra Nu Samay Fizza.
Kazim Di Ghurbat Wich Ro Ro Be-Haal Aye Kul Ajdad Hoya.
Aynj Gal Wich Tauq Zanjeeraan Te Pairaan Wich Aablay Bhari Ne.
Lagda Aye Qaidi Kazim Nayi Ik Wari Fair Sajjad Hoya.

3
Mujha Gaye Shajar Fizawaan Wich Har Pasay Udasi Chayi Aye.
Qatil De Zulm Toon Qatal Ewein Wasda Sara Baghdada Hoya.
Aye Jam Shahdat Da Pee Ke Dunya Toon Parda Kar Gaya Si.
Par Sanwaan Mukiyaan Raza Te Ja Zeeshan Zulm Aiday Bad Hoya.

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/zindan-che-musa-kazim-da-aj-loko-khatam-jahad-hoya-lyrics-punjabi-2019-tajpoints-a202d554ae93ccfe176c.md')
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---\\n', 2)[2].strip()
_, meta, body = p.read_text().split('---\\n', 2)
roman = '\\n'.join(line.removeprefix('  ') for line in meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines()).strip()
assert roman.casefold() == old.casefold().replace('.\\n', '\\n').rstrip('.')
for edition, numbers in [(roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')]:
    blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert [block[0] for block in blocks] == list(numbers)
    assert [len(block) - 1 for block in blocks] == [4, 4, 4]
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Verified Roman wording and three matching four-verse stanzas.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the original Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both editions have three matching four-verse stanzas. Updated the titles and script metadata and removed the missing-source tag.

The Roman readings “Kariyaan Paye” and “Samay Fizza” are ambiguous. I rendered them phonetically as `کڑیاں پئے` and `سمے فضہ`, and read “Mujha” as `مرجھا` in the line about trees.
